inputs.text: The owner approved making Anatomed local-first, with an approximately 27 MB local anatomy asset set, and approved registration and implementation.
The owner requires the implementation to be installed and tested locally in their Obsidian before any release.
Supabase cleanup must happen only after local acceptance and a separate explicit destructive approval.
The current plugin defaults to the Supabase models bucket for GLBs and parts-neighbors.json, while parts-catalog.json is bundled into main.js.

Obsidian Community Plugins automatically downloads only main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css from a matching GitHub release, so additional local model files require an explicit install or bootstrap path.
